fullDescription: A cream, editorial SaaS pricing page laid out as a pastel bento grid with a dark hero plan, serif headlines, and a live monthly/yearly toggle.

structured.summary: A warm, editorial SaaS pricing page for an AI design-prompt tool, built as a frameless responsive bento grid. A cream-paper backdrop with subtle dot grain holds soft pastel rounded tiles (one dramatic dark Pro tile, lilac Free, peach Studio, mint feature strip, white Enterprise) arranged in an asymmetric 12-column layout. Big serif display headlines mix with a clean geometric sans; a Monthly/Yearly toggle swaps prices live. The transferable value is the look (cream + pastel-tile palette, Fraunces serif + Plus Jakarta Sans, tabular-num price numerals) and the bento pricing structure (one hero plan, two pastel side plans, a benefits strip, a wide enterprise row, FAQ, footer CTA).

style.description: Soft, premium, editorial-but-friendly. A cream paper canvas with a faint radial dot grain, pastel rounded tiles each in its own hue, one high-contrast near-black hero tile with blurred colored glow blobs. Type pairs an optical serif display (Fraunces) for headlines and prices against a clean geometric sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) for body and UI. Generous rounding (rounded-3xl tiles), soft shadows, hairline ink-tinted rings, and tabular-num price numerals with tight letter-spacing. No em-dashes anywhere in copy.
style.prompt: Use a warm editorial pastel aesthetic. Background: cream #FBF7F0 with a subtle radial dot grain (radial-gradient of rgba(43,39,48,0.025) 1px dots on a 4px grid). Core palette: ink (near-black) #2B2730 for text/dark tiles, muted text #5E5667. Pastel tile fills each paired with a deeper accent for icons/markers that stays AA-readable: lilac tile #EBE3FA with accent #6A4BB0 (and #9B7BE0), peach tile #FCE5D8 with accent #A04518 (#E8825A), mint tile #DCF0E4 with accent #1A6E45 (#3FA873), sky accents #DCE9FB / #2C5FA8, butter CTA tile #FBF0D2 with #835A0E. White #FFFFFF for the Enterprise and FAQ cards. Typography: 'Fraunces' (opsz serif, weights 400-700) for display headlines, prices and plan names, often italic for the accent phrase in the lilac-deep color; 'Plus Jakarta Sans' (400-800) for body, nav, buttons. Prices use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and letter-spacing -0.03em. Tiles are rounded-3xl with soft shadows and 1px ink/5-ish rings; the dark hero tile gets a heavy drop shadow plus two large blurred pastel glow blobs (lilac and peach) bleeding off its corners. Hover: tiles lift translateY(-4px). Buttons are pill or rounded-2xl, near-black bg with cream text, or white/ring-outline secondary. Light, no em-dashes.

layout_and_structure.description: A frameless responsive single-column web page on a max-w-7xl centered container. The pricing block is a bento grid: a 12-column CSS grid on large screens that reflows 3 -> 2 -> 1 columns on tablet/mobile. A sticky blurred nav sits on top, then a centered hero with a billing toggle, then the bento tiles, a wide Enterprise row, a two-column FAQ, and a footer CTA band.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top-0 z-50 header with backdrop-blur and a translucent cream/80 background and a hairline bottom border (ink/5). Inside a max-w-7xl row (h-16): left = brand lockup, a 36px rounded-xl ink square with a cream sparkle icon next to the Fraunces wordmark 'Promptboard' (~22px, weight 600). Center (hidden on mobile) = text links Library, Templates, Showcase, Pricing in muted weight-500, with the current page (Pricing) in solid ink. Right = a ghost 'Log in' link plus a near-black pill 'Start free' button with a right-arrow icon. On mobile, collapse center+login into a hamburger that toggles a full-width dropdown panel.

Centered hero, max-w-7xl, generous top padding. A small lilac pill badge ('Pricing', uppercase, lilac-deep text, palette icon). Then a large Fraunces display H1 (clamp ~2.4rem to 4.4rem, leading ~0.98, weight 600): 'Pricing that scales' with the phrase 'with your imagination' in italic lilac-deep. A muted sub-paragraph (~17-19px, max-w-xl): 'Thousands of design prompts, one infinite canvas. Pick the plan that turns your ideas into shippable UI fastest.' Below, a centered Monthly/Yearly billing toggle: a white pill containing 'Monthly' label, a 52x28 rounded track with a sliding white dot, and a 'Yearly' label followed by a mint '-20%' savings chip. Toggling adds an is-yearly state that slides the dot, darkens the track to ink, swaps the active label colors, and swaps all monthly prices to discounted yearly prices via show/hide spans.

prompts.part: Bento pricing grid (the pricing layout itself)
prompts.partPt: Bento Planos e Preços grid (the Planos e Preços layout itself)
prompts.prompt: A bento grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-12, gap ~16-20px, auto-rows-min, inside max-w-7xl. Five tiles: (1) PRO hero tile, lg:col-span-5 lg:row-span-2, dark ink background with cream text, heavy shadow and two blurred pastel glow blobs; header row has 'Pro' (Fraunces 28px) and a 'Most popular' chip with a butter star; a one-line description; a huge price block '$24 / month' (Fraunces 64px, tabular-nums) that swaps to '$19' + '$228 billed yearly' in yearly mode; a full-width cream 'Start 14-day trial' button; a 6-item feature list with mint check-circle icons (Unlimited generations, 8,000+ prompts, infinite canvas + version history, coding-agent skill Claude Code/Cursor, export to React/HTML/Figma, priority support); a footer micro-line with a shield icon 'Cancel anytime. Your canvas, your designs, forever.' (2) FREE tile, lg:col-span-4, lilac fill, ring + soft shadow: icon-chip + 'Free', '$0 forever', short blurb, 3 check-bold items (30 generations/month, 200 starter prompts, 1 canvas community support), white outline 'Get started free' button. (3) STUDIO tile, lg:col-span-3, peach fill: icon-chip + 'Studio', '$59 / mo' (swaps to $47 yearly), 'Per seat, for small product teams.', 3 items (Everything in Pro, Shared team canvases, Brand kits & design tokens), near-black 'Start team trial' button. (4) FEATURE STRIP, lg:col-span-7, mint fill, flex row on desktop: left = uppercase mint-deep eyebrow 'In every paid plan' with infinity icon, Fraunces headline 'No credit roulette. Generate without the dread.', muted blurb about flat pricing/transparent limits/full prompt history; right = a 3-up stat grid of white/70 mini-cards (8k+ Prompts, 12 Frameworks, infinity Canvas). All tiles use rounded-3xl and the hover-lift. On lg, Pro spans two rows on the left while Free+Studio sit top-right and the mint strip sits beneath them; everything reflows to 2-up then single column on smaller screens.

A full-width white tile below the grid (rounded-3xl, ring ink/8, soft shadow), flex row on desktop. Left column (max-w-sm): sky icon-chip with a buildings icon + 'Enterprise' (Fraunces 26px), muted description about custom rollout / security review / design-systems partner, a 'Let's talk' Fraunces price with 'custom volume' caption, and a near-black 'Contact sales' button with arrow. Right column: a 2-3 column grid of feature items each with a sky check-circle icon (SSO & SAML, Audit logs, Dedicated manager, Private prompt vault, Custom SLAs, Onboarding workshop), separated from the left by a vertical hairline border on large screens.

Centered max-w-4xl section. Fraunces H2 'Questions, answered' (clamp ~1.8-2.6rem) with a muted sub-line 'Still curious? Ping us and we'll sort it together.' Below, a 2-column grid (single column on mobile) of white rounded-2xl cards (ring ink/8). Each card: a bold question with a colored question-mark icon (rotating lilac/peach/mint/sky accents) and a muted answer paragraph. Questions: What counts as a generation? / Can I switch plans later? / Do you offer a free trial? / Who owns my designs?

prompts.partPt: Rodapé Chamada Final para Ação band
prompts.prompt: A footer with a top hairline border. A butter-colored rounded-3xl CTA band (flex row): left = Fraunces 'Start designing in 60 seconds.' with sub 'No card. First mockup on the house.'; right = a near-black pill 'Open the canvas' button with up-right arrow. Below the band, a thin footer row: brand lockup ('Promptboard' + copyright) on the left and muted Privacy / Terms / Changelog links on the right.

special_ui_components.description: A white pill switch with Monthly and Yearly labels flanking a sliding-dot track, plus a mint '-20%' savings chip on the Yearly side.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a single checkbox-driven toggle. White rounded-full pill (ink/10 border, subtle shadow) containing: 'Monthly' label (weight 700), a 52x28 rounded track with a 22px white dot at left, and 'Yearly' label with a small mint '-20%' chip (mint-deep text). When checked, add an is-yearly class to the body that: darkens the track to ink #2B2730, slides the dot ~26px right, dims the Monthly label and brightens Yearly, and swaps every price by toggling .monthly spans off and .yearly spans on (e.g. $24 -> $19, $59 -> $47, 'Billed monthly' -> '$228 billed yearly'). Pure CSS state via a peer/body class, driven by a tiny change listener.

special_ui_components.component: Dark hero pricing tile with glow blobs
special_ui_components.description: The Pro plan tile: a near-black rounded card that anchors the bento, lifted with a heavy shadow and two large blurred pastel light blobs bleeding off its corners.
special_ui_components.prompt: A rounded-3xl ink #2B2730 tile with cream text, lg spanning 5 of 12 columns and 2 rows. Heavy soft drop shadow (0 24px 60px -24px rgba(43,39,48,0.55)). Position two absolutely-placed, blurred (blur-3xl) circular glow blobs off the corners: a lilac blob (#9B7BE0 ~30% opacity) top-right and a peach blob (#E8825A ~20%) bottom-left, with overflow hidden so they bleed softly. Content sits in a relative layer above the blobs: title row with a 'Most popular' ring chip, large tabular-nums price, full-width cream CTA, mint-check feature list, and a shield-icon reassurance line pinned to the bottom via mt-auto.

special_ui_components.description: A 3-up grid of translucent white cards inside the mint feature strip showing headline numbers (8k+ Prompts, 12 Frameworks, infinity Canvas).
special_ui_components.prompt: Inside the mint feature strip, a 3-column grid of rounded-2xl white/70 cards, each centered: a large Fraunces tabular-nums number in mint-deep (#1A6E45) over a small muted uppercase label. Values: '8k+' / Prompts, '12' / Frameworks, infinity symbol / Canvas. Keeps the strip scannable and reinforces the flat-pricing / no-credit-anxiety message.

structured.special_notes: Frameless responsive web page (no device/browser chrome). The whole layout is a max-w-7xl centered container on a cream body with a faint dot-grain overlay. The bento grid is the centerpiece: a 12-column CSS grid where Pro spans 5 cols x 2 rows, Free 4 cols, Studio 3 cols, and the mint strip 7 cols, all reflowing 3 -> 2 -> 1 column on tablet then mobile. Sticky blurred nav with a working mobile hamburger dropdown. Two icon sets in play via Iconify Phosphor (ph:*). Copy voice is warm and human with zero em-dashes. The billing toggle and price swap are the only required interactivity. Pastel accents must use the deepened accent hex values (lilacDeep/peachDeep/mintDeep/skyDeep) for any text or markers so they stay AA-readable on their tile.
